rule: A column is placed by its header alone, by the first pattern that matches it, in the order shown. A cell says the record's table has such a column: 'varied' when it holds more than one value, 'single' when every filled cell holds the same value. Dates and times are set aside, and so are identifiers and notes that no pattern claims. A header no pattern names is listed as not placed.

flow_words.rule: A row is listed when a cell of its table's air-flow columns holds one of these words, tried in this order: 'blowoff'; 'no ign'; 'would not stay lit'; 'ext', 'extinguished' or 'out'; or a 0 standing alone. Columns of plain numbers are not read, and the cells are shown as NASA wrote them. 'ext' is read as extinction. 'off' is not counted: after a list of fan settings it may mean the fan. A 0 among the settings says what a display read, not that the air stood still.
